content.json:
# 📅 Resource Creation & Cost Run-Rate
Month-by-month view of what was created in Azure, when, what it costs, and how much recurring spend each month added.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Monthly cost added** | New recurring monthly charge introduced by resources created that month |
| **Cumulative run-rate** | Total estimated monthly bill carried by everything created up to that month |
| **Est. cost since creation** | Run-rate × age, i.e. rough spend to date |

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query: resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups' | project value = tolower(name), label = name | order by label asc

content.json: 💰 **Estimated unit prices** — approximate US East list prices. Adjust for your region, currency and discounts; every cost column recalculates. Set *Any other resource type* above 0 to give uncosted types a nominal value.

## Resources created per month
Creation dates come from each resource's own `timeCreated` / `creationTime` property in Azure Resource Graph. Types that don't expose a creation property are excluded here — use the **All creation dates (ARM)** tab for full coverage.

`Monthly cost added` = the estimated *recurring* monthly charge introduced by everything created in that month.

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend Created = coalesce(
    todatetime(properties.timeCreated),
    todatetime(properties.creationTime),
    todatetime(properties.createdTime),
    todatetime(properties.createdOn),
    todatetime(properties.creationDate),
    todatetime(properties.dateCreated),
    todatetime(properties.provisioningTime))
| where isnotnull(Created)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', todouble('{PriceFirewall}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', todouble('{PriceVpnGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', todouble('{PriceSqlDb}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' or type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', todouble('{PriceDbServer}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', todouble('{PriceAks}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', todouble('{PriceStorageAcct}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    todouble('{PriceOther}')), 2)
| where Created >= datetime({TimeRange:startISO}) and Created <= datetime({TimeRange:endISO})
| summarize ['Resources created'] = count(),
            ['Run-rate added (monthly)'] = round(sum(['Est. monthly cost']), 2),
            ['Annualised'] = round(sum(['Est. monthly cost']) * 12, 2),
            ['First created'] = min(Created),
            ['Latest created'] = max(Created)

## Every resource with its creation date and estimated cost
Filter the grid or export to Excel. `Age (days)` and `Cost since creation` show how much a resource has accumulated at its estimated run-rate.

| extend Created = coalesce(
    todatetime(properties.timeCreated),

    todatetime(properties.createdOn),
    todatetime(properties.creationDate),
    todatetime(properties.dateCreated),
    todatetime(properties.provisioningTime))
| where isnotnull(Created)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', todouble('{PriceFirewall}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', todouble('{PriceVpnGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', todouble('{PriceSqlDb}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' or type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', todouble('{PriceDbServer}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', todouble('{PriceAks}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', todouble('{PriceStorageAcct}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    todouble('{PriceOther}')), 2)
| where Created >= datetime({TimeRange:startISO}) and Created <= datetime({TimeRange:endISO})
| extend ['Age (days)'] = toint(datetime_diff('day', now(), Created))
| extend ['Est. cost since creation'] = round(['Est. monthly cost'] * (toreal(['Age (days)']) / 30.4), 2)
| extend Owner = tostring(tags['Owner']), CostCenter = tostring(tags['CostCenter'])
| project Name = name, Created, Month = format_datetime(startofmonth(Created), 'yyyy-MM'), ['Age (days)'], Type = type, ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup, Location = location, ['Est. monthly cost'], ['Est. cost since creation'], Owner, CostCenter, ['Open resource'] = id
| order by Created desc
content.title: Resources by creation date ({Currency})

content.query:
resources
| where '{ResourceGroups:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend Created = coalesce(
    todatetime(properties.timeCreated),
    todatetime(properties.creationTime),
    todatetime(properties.createdTime),
    todatetime(properties.createdOn),
    todatetime(properties.creationDate),
    todatetime(properties.dateCreated),
    todatetime(properties.provisioningTime))
| where isnotnull(Created)
| extend ['Est. monthly cost'] = round(case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * case(tostring(sku.name) has 'Ultra', todouble('{PriceDiskUltra}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'Premium', todouble('{PriceDiskPremium}'), tostring(sku.name) has 'StandardSSD', todouble('{PriceDiskSSD}'), todouble('{PriceDiskHDD}')),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', toreal(properties.diskSizeGB) * todouble('{PriceSnapshot}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', todouble('{PriceVMHour}') * 730.0,
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', todouble('{PricePublicIP}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', todouble('{PriceLB}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', todouble('{PriceAppGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', todouble('{PriceFirewall}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', todouble('{PriceVpnGw}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', todouble('{PriceSqlDb}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' or type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', todouble('{PriceDbServer}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', todouble('{PriceAks}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', todouble('{PriceStorageAcct}'),
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms', todouble(coalesce(toint(sku.capacity),1)) * case(tostring(sku.tier) has 'Isolated', todouble('{PricePlanIsolated}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Premium', todouble('{PricePlanPremium}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Standard', todouble('{PricePlanStandard}'), tostring(sku.tier) has 'Basic', todouble('{PricePlanBasic}'), 0.0),
    todouble('{PriceOther}')), 2)
| where Created >= datetime({TimeRange:startISO}) and Created <= datetime({TimeRange:endISO})
| summarize ['Resources created'] = count(), ['Monthly cost added'] = round(sum(['Est. monthly cost']), 2) by ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup
| order by ['Monthly cost added'] desc
| take 30
content.title: Creation activity by resource group
